lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Quick review: value of 6 in 6,308; order 2,085 and 2,805; estimate 2,990 + 20.

FEEDBACK
6,000; 2,085 < 2,805; about 3,010 (or 3,000).

WATCH FOR
Reviewing only final answers without place reasons misses the unit focus.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Review chain: partition 4,070 → compare with 4,700 → estimate 4,070 + 800 ≈ 4,900 → exact 4,870 near the estimate.

TRY FIRST
Quick review: value of 6 in 6,308; order 2,085 and 2,805; estimate 2,990 + 20.

FEEDBACK
6,000; 2,085 < 2,805; about 3,010 (or 3,000).
teach_steps.explain:
Unit review connects reading, partitioning, comparing and estimating so place-value ideas work together.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Reviewing only final answers without place reasons misses the unit focus. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
teach_steps.title: Understand and model
